fields.note: Plascore PAMG-XR1 5052 prints bare compression and L/W plate shear. It prints no stabilised compressive modulus and no crush column. Ec is the Hexcel CR-III 5052 stabilised modulus at the same cell and nominal pcf. Crush is Plascore's bare compressive typical, which is the 1.29 MPa the brief names at 3/16-2.0. That bare value is not the Hexcel crush-column test.
